newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada employment insurance claims rise in January.
newsitem.headline: Canada employment insurance claims rise in January.

text.p: The number of Canadians who applied for employment insurance benefits in January rose 3.5 percent to 241,000 from 233,000 in December, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.
The rise was led by Ontario, where claims rose 8.3 percent, the federal agency said.
But the estimated number of Canadians who received regular employment insurance benefits declined 6.1 percent in January to 619,380 seasonally adjusted from about 660,000 in December, Statscan said.

Declines were recorded in all provinces and territories except the Yukon. The downward trend in the number of beneficiaries throughout 1996 continued into January, reaching levels not seen since the early 1980s.
Regular benefit payments increased 0.8 percent in January to C$766.1 million from C$760.3 million in December, the agency said. Payments have remained flat for the last seven months.
(For more information from Statistics Canada, contact Michael Scrim, Labor Division, 613-951-4090.)
